summary: Batch 3 verification — accounts/participants v2, plan branch logic, free-tool monthly gate, seat limits, frontend smoke for /pricing, /app/participants, and /ai-tools/statement-decoder. 18/20 backend pytest tests pass (2 skipped intentionally due to missing setup primitives, not bugs). Batch 2 regression: 13/13 pass. Statement Decoder Round 3 regression: 1/1 pass. Free-tool gate end-to-end (anon decode #1 → 200, decode #2 → 429 monthly_limit) verified directly via API. All required UI elements render correctly including Pricing page (4 plans, Most Popular Family, comparison table with 11 section dividers, 7 FAQ items), Participants page (1 active counter, Dorothy card with coloured border, 'Covered by Solo plan' tag, forwarding email dorothy-1c8113@in.wayly.com.au + copy button, Add participant button), Add-participant modal (exact 'Plan: Solo $19/month → Family $39/month' branch text), and Statement Decoder usage banner ('1 of 1 free decode remaining this month · resets 7/1/2026'). The header participant switcher shows Dorothy avatar + L4 classification badge + coloured left border + SOLO plan badge. Cathy's account was NOT modified during testing — all participant-add flows used fresh signup users.

Review request mentions this field exists on the solo_to_family auto-upgrade path; we did not directly exercise that path (would require promoting a test user to SOLO, which has no admin endpoint exposed). Manually confirmed by main agent prior.

Hard-delete confirm_full_name is case-insensitive (verified 'zara KHAN' matches 'Zara Khan'). Good UX.

Free-tool monthly gate: fresh fingerprint+UA combo correctly tracked; 2nd decode returns proper HTTP 429 with structured detail {error:'monthly_limit', reset_at, period_month, used_count}. Logged-in cathy bypasses gate (used_count=0, allowed=true).
SOLO plan caregiver-seat limit (1) enforced with HTTP 409 + detail.error='seat_limit' on invite attempt.

Pricing page comparison table has all 11 advertised section dividers and exactly 7 FAQ items — meets the 'at least 7' threshold but is at the floor; consider adding 1-2 more FAQ entries (e.g., 'How does the free tool gate work?', 'What happens if my Stripe payment fails?').
Forwarding email format `dorothy-1c8113@in.wayly.com.au` matches the v2 schema spec exactly.
Participant switcher in header shows 'Dorothy L4' with classification badge + coloured left border + primary indicator — meets all visual requirements.
Add-participant modal copy is excellent and uses the exact required branch text 'Plan: Solo $19/month → Family $39/month' (with em-dash → arrow).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 3 is fully implemented and stable. The 2 pytest skips in test_batch3_features.py are intentional: (1) test_solo_to_family_auto_upgrade requires an admin endpoint to promote a fresh signup user to SOLO plan with 1 participant (only cathy fits and we shouldn't pollute her); (2) test_non_owner_403_on_add requires a multi-user invite-accept flow which isn't directly exposed for automated testing here. Both flows were manually verified by the main agent. If a future session adds a test-only admin promotion endpoint, those two skips can be converted to real tests.
